info.title: Nexus CRM API
info.description:
REST API for the Nexus CRM application.

## Authentication

Two auth methods are supported:

- **BearerAuth** – `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Per-user API token generated in the dashboard. Scoped to the token owner's data (admin tokens get cross-tenant read access).
- **CookieAuth** – Session cookie set by the Better Auth `/api/auth` flow (Google OAuth).

Token management (POST/DELETE `/api/token`) requires a session cookie. File downloads require CookieAuth or BearerAuth; unauthenticated sharing uses per-link `/s/{code}` URLs scoped to the link owner.

BearerAuth.description: Per-user API token generated via the dashboard (POST /api/token). Scoped to the token owner's data. Admin users' tokens get cross-tenant read access.

CookieAuth.name: better-auth.session_token
CookieAuth.description: Session cookie issued by the Better Auth flow at `/api/auth`. Admin users (isAdmin=true) bypass per-user filtering.

ApplicationStatus.description: Current stage of the opportunity pipeline.

ContactRef.description: A contact person associated with an application.

Document.description: An uploaded document (PDF, image) attached to one or more applications.

SubmissionPolicyInput.description: Human-reviewed integrity attestation required for every new submission. It may be omitted only when replaying an exact pre-policy legacy request.

confirmedNoAnswers.description: Set true only when the external form contained no application answers; conflicts with a non-empty answers array.

SubmissionPolicySnapshot.description: Immutable normalized integrity attestation. Legacy submissions created before policy persistence may contain an empty object.

confirmedNoAnswers.description: Set true only when the external form contained no application answers; conflicts with a non-empty answers array.

ApplicationSubmission.description: Immutable snapshot of one application submission. Exact answers are sensitive.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user has admin privileges (sees all tenants).

ApiTokenInfo.description: API token metadata (never includes the raw token).

Forbidden.description: Insufficient permissions — admin privileges required or resource does not belong to the authenticated user.

NotFound.description: Resource not found or does not belong to the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns all applications for the authenticated user, ordered by creation date descending. Admin users see all applications across tenants.

post.description: Creates a new application owned by the session user.

get.description: Returns a single application by ID. Access is scoped to the authenticated user (admin users see all).

patch.description: Partially updates an application. All fields are optional. **Requires a session.**

delete.description: Deletes an application and its related contacts. **Requires a session.**

post.description: Preserves exact answers, integrity-policy attestations, compensation, document versions, status, follow-up, and a timeline event. New submissions require a reviewed policy, at least one document, and either answers or confirmedNoAnswers. Exact pre-policy legacy requests remain replayable by idempotency key. Supports dry-run and optimistic concurrency.

oneOf.title: ExactLegacySubmissionReplayRequest
oneOf.description: Compatibility shape only for an exact idempotent replay of a submission created before policy enforcement. Every supplied value must match the historical request after the former REST coercions.

201.description: Newly recorded submission package, including the immutable policy snapshot.

400.description: Invalid answers, documents, salary fields, or missing/failed integrity attestation.

409.description: Idempotency, optimistic-concurrency, duplicate requisition/job/application, same-company active-process, repeat-submission, or document-reuse conflict.

idempotencyKey.description: When supplied, occurredAt is required so retries hash deterministically.

post.description: Creates a contact associated with the given application. **Requires a session.** The application must belong to the authenticated user.

patch.description: Partially updates a contact. All fields are optional. **Requires a session.** The parent application must belong to the authenticated user.

delete.description: Deletes a contact. **Requires a session.** The parent application must belong to the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns all documents for the authenticated user, ordered by upload date descending. Each document includes its linked applications. Admin users see all documents.

post.description: Uploads a file (PDF, JPEG, PNG, or WEBP; max 10 MB). Optionally links the document to one or more applications owned by the session user. **Requires a session.**

file.description: The file to upload. Allowed MIME types: `application/pdf`, `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`. Maximum size: 10 MB.

applicationIds.description: JSON-encoded array of application IDs to link, e.g. `[1, 2, 3]`.

413.description: File exceeds the 10 MB size limit.

example.error: Unsupported file type. Allowed: PDF, JPEG, PNG, WEBP

patch.description: Replaces the set of applications linked to this document. Provide a complete `applicationIds` array — this is a *set* operation, not a merge. **Requires a session.**

applicationIds.description: Complete list of application IDs to link. Only IDs owned by the session user are accepted.

200.description: Updated document with new application links.

delete.description: Deletes the document record and removes the file from disk. **Requires a session.**

get.description: Streams the raw file with the original filename as the download name. Access requires a session cookie or per-user Bearer token scoped to the document owner. Public read tokens are disabled; unauthenticated document sharing is handled via per-link `/s/{code}` URLs.

200.description: Raw file binary. `Content-Type` reflects the stored MIME type.

get.description: Returns metadata about the authenticated user's API token, or null if none exists. Does not return the raw token.

post.description: Generates a new per-user API token. If a token already exists, it is revoked first. The raw token is returned only once in the response. **Requires a session** (Bearer tokens cannot create new tokens).

201.description: Newly created token. The `raw` field contains the token value (shown only once).

raw.description: The raw API token. Copy it now — it will not be shown again.

delete.description: Revokes the authenticated user's API token. **Requires a session.**

get.description: Returns all registered users. **Requires admin privileges.**

patch.description: Sets or revokes admin privileges for a user. Cannot remove the last admin. **Requires admin privileges.**

isAdmin.description: Whether the user should have admin privileges.

get.description: Deprecated endpoint. Global PUBLIC_READ_TOKEN based access is disabled to prevent cross-account data exposure. Use per-link share URLs (`/s/{code}`) instead.

error.example: Public read tokens are disabled. Use per-link share URLs instead.
